approved.en: President Trump has waived several Russia sanctions, easing oil restrictions and prompting Zelenskyy to accuse him of rewarding Putin while seeking European support. Russian forces have launched overnight attacks on civilian energy facilities across Ukraine, killing civilians and cutting power for over a million people. Ukrainian forces are advancing, pushing Russian troops back with Starlink communications playing a key role. The conflict caused 75,767 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
approved.nb: President Trump har opphevet flere russiske sanksjoner, lettet olje­restriksjoner og fått Zelenskyj til å anklage ham for å belønne Putin mens han søker europeisk støtte. Russiske styrker har gjennomført nattlige angrep på sivile energianlegg over hele Ukraina, drept sivile og kuttet strømmen til mer enn en million mennesker. Ukrainske styrker gjør framrykk, skyver russiske tropper tilbake med Starlink-kommunikasjon som en viktig faktor. Konflikten forårsaket 75 767 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Hezbollah explosives seized from two Lebanese trucks have led Lebanon's prime minister and security forces to promise a thorough investigation while Israeli artillery and air strikes continue against Hezbollah positions in southern Lebanon, causing civilian casualties. In northern Israel a Hezbollah submunition exploded in a teenager's backpack, killing Elazar Yair Wilensky and wounding dozens, prompting an IDF probe and possible hike restrictions. Qatar has pledged funding for reconstruction in southern Lebanon, announced a massive solar plant project, and its foreign minister called for Israeli withdrawal from Lebanon. The UCDP recorded 4,335 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

I Nord-Israel eksploderte en Hezbollah-submunisjon i en tenårings ryggsekk, og drepte Elazar Yair Wilensky og såret dusinvis, noe som har ført til en IDF-undersøkelse og mulige restriksjoner på høyde. Qatar har lovet finansiering til gjenoppbygging i Sør-Libanon, kunngjort et massivt solkraftprosjekt, og utenriksministeren oppfordret til israelsk tilbaketrekning fra Libanon. Azerbaijan is hosting a rare summit that brings together leaders from the conflicted Middle East and Asia. The conflict recorded 123 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

approved.en: Syrian authorities abducted a suspect in an Assad-era massacre from Lebanon and arrested the “Butcher of Baniyas” for the 2013 coastal massacres, while two Syrian pipelines were damaged in recent attacks on energy infrastructure. Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu spoke directly with President Ahmed al-Sharaa after a 2025 strike in Damascus, a conversation that Syrian sources said involved U.S. and Arab mediation, and a Druze leader praised Netanyahu’s intervention. A Syrian soldier was killed and another seriously injured while clearing mines in the Homs countryside. Authorities foiled an ISIS plot to target a police patrol in Damascus countryside. The conflict produced 2,732 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Israels statsminister Netanyahu snakket direkte med president Ahmed al-Sharaa etter et angrep i Damaskus i 2025, en samtale som syriske kilder sa involverte amerikansk og arabisk mekling, og en drusisk leder roste Netanyahus inngripen. En syrisk soldat ble drept og en annen ble alvorlig såret mens de ryddet miner på landsbygda i Homs. Myndighetene avverget et IS-plan om å angripe en politipatrulje på landsbygda i Damaskus. Konflikten førte til 2 732 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Communal clashes continue as SPLA-IO forces retook Akobo and SSPDF soldiers were wounded in an assault on a Mundri West military outpost, while fighting in Unity State raised the death toll to 29 and SSPDF reported 40 deaths in Rumbek clashes, contradicting a ministry figure of 71. A high court sentenced five officers to 24 years for raiding a general's home and a pastor received death threats in a refugee camp. The EU and Germany-funded SGBV prevention project concluded after four years, ASK Foundation and German doctors began free cleft surgery for 20 children in Juba, and South Sudan urged vigilance after Ebola outbreaks in neighboring DRC and Uganda. Two battle-related deaths were recorded in 2024, according to UCDP.

En høyesterett dømte fem offiserer til 24 år for å ha plyndret en generals hjem, og en pastor mottok trusler om døden i en flyktningleir. EU‑ og Tyskland-finansierte forebyggingsprosjektet mot kjønnsvold avsluttet etter fire år, ASK-stiftelsen og tyske leger startet gratis leppe‑ og ganespalteoperasjoner for 20 barn i Juba, og Sør-Sudan oppfordret til årvåkenhet etter ebolautbrudd i nabolandene DRC og Uganda. To dødsfall knyttet til kamper ble registrert i 2024, ifølge UCDP.
